styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF packshots alternating with a matte pale mist panel #EEF2F6 for benefit and infographic screens

styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, thin charcoal rules, all rendered copy left to post-production
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in cool grey-blue #7C9AB5, kept as empty slots in template
styleLock.presentationRules: garment always shown on a headless invisible-mannequin form or flat lay, consistent button-placket facing, stable scale, symmetrical sleeve spacing, no face and no limbs
noDrift: no random textured backgrounds or lifestyle props
no inconsistent lighting or hard speculars

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium womenswear tailoring visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, matte pale mist panel #EEF2F6, deep charcoal rules #2D2D2D and one cool grey-blue accent #7C9AB5; bright even high-key studio lighting at 5500K with a front-left key, soft fill and a sweeping side light skimming the fabric, soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with thin single-weight line icons; garments presented on a headless invisible-mannequin form or in a symmetric flat lay; stable garment scale and placket facing; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no model identity.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 与 002 为同一隐形人台白底正面挂拍（门襟敞开度与袖口翻折略有差异，属近重复）；003 为同件背面挂拍，可见过肩育克缝、后中片与圆弧摆、双扣袖口；004 为横版信息图，服装居右、左侧三行细分隔线配英文卖点行；005 为 2x2 微距四宫格（领座、门襟钉扣、布纹折、袖克夫）。品类判定依据：以图为准，收腰省与 X 型腰线、圆弧长短摆、尖领法式克夫判定为女士外穿长袖上衣，故归 女装/上衣（源平台类目同为女装，无需改判）；非贴身衣，故不入 内衣家居服。变体闸门结论：5 张全为同一浅色款的正/背/信息图/细节分工，不是仅换色的色卡陈列，正常转化。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与店铺字样、领口尺码标字样、004 三行原文案整句及其中的面料成分百分比（改为空白标签条占位）、任何平台徽章与星级角标、原图文案排版用词；模特本即为无头隐形人台，模版内一律不写面容与身份，仅保留挂拍与平铺结构。
